# Frontend Core UI System Full Guide

Use this guide for scalable component architecture and UX consistency.

## Scope

- Component composition and API design
- Accessibility and semantic structure
- Responsive behavior and feedback states
- Token-driven styling consistency

## Core Playbook

1. Choose correct primitive/composition model.
2. Build semantic, keyboard-safe interactions.
3. Apply responsive and visual system constraints.
4. Validate behavior parity across breakpoints.
